about.summary: Aditya is a Computer Science undergraduate student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at K.R. Mangalam University (expected graduation May 2027). He has hands-on experience building end-to-end ML pipelines, with skills in data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation using Python and Scikit-learn. He has successfully completed multiple Machine Learning and Data Science internships and holds a strong foundation in data structures, problem solving, and applied machine learning workflows.

• Applied feature engineering and supported predictive modeling workflows.
